description: Enlarged and cut 35mm contact sheet of five images of various rockface formations, including Tapestry Wall, and a close up of Marshall Gerard lying down in the raft. Visible filmstrip numbers: 28, 29, 30. Todd Webb printed most of O'Keeffe's contact sheets and photographic prints. This photograph is from the Glen Canyon album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe "In memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River."
title: Glen Canyon, contact sheet
